item.title: ‘BTS World Tour ‘Arirang’ in Busan: Live Viewing’ Movie Event Coming to Theaters
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Get ready, ARMY! BTS is making a big comeback to the big screen, and we've got all the details. The K-pop supergroup is set to perform at the Busan Asiad Main Stadium in South Korea on June 12 and 13, and the show will be broadcast live in theaters around the world on June 13."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This global live cinema event, called BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’ IN BUSAN: LIVE VIEWING, will mark the group's return to the iconic 53,000-seat venue after a nearly four-year absence from concert stages. And what's even more special is that it coincides with the 13th anniversary of their debut."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Tickets for the live event go on sale on May 28, and in select regions, the broadcast will be delayed to accommodate local time zones. The event's organizer, Trafalgar Releasing, is excited to bring this experience to fans globally, and we can't wait to see it."
[Short music transition]
Host: "BTS has been making waves recently, dropping their 10th album, ARIRANG, which debuted at number one on the Billboard 200, and kicking off their massive 34-city, 85-show tour. They're also making a special appearance at the American Music Awards on May 25, where they're nominated in three categories."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Don't miss out on this exciting opportunity to see BTS on the big screen. Mark your calendars for June 13, and get ready to celebrate the group's anniversary with fans around the world."
